title: alp-sdk Linux kernel driver availability (v1)
description: Which Linux sensor drivers a BSP kernel carries, so a camera module can be checked against the kernel it will run on: a driver is either NATIVE to the kernel or provided by an alp kernel patch under meta-alp-sdk/recipes-kernel/linux/.  Keyed by the exact kernel version string.

bsp.description: BSP the kernel belongs to, e.g. the RZ/V2N BSP.

compatible.description: Linux compatible the driver matches (a chip's `drivers.linux.compatible`).

native.description: true = the stock kernel already contains the driver; false = it exists only through `patches`.

native_lanes.description: CSI-2 data-lane counts the NATIVE driver accepts, when it is restricted.  Omit for no restriction.

patches.description: alp patch filenames (in meta-alp-sdk/recipes-kernel/linux/linux-renesas/) that add the driver or extend it (extra lane counts, modes).
